topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Well, there it was, a letter all the way from the town, meant for the Miller who once lived in this very cottage. I scratched my head, pondered what to do with such a thing. Decided it best to open it, maybe there was something of value inside, something that belonged here now. Inside, there were tales of debts cleared and a fine barley sell he'd made just before moving on. I reckon it's good fortune for us, not just any old letter. I took it to the lord, showed him what the Miller had, and he nodded, saying maybe we could plant some of that fine barley seed next harvest. People in the village are saying it’s a sign from the saints, a good start for us in this new place. I reckon they might be right.
